title: Link batch
description: The body of one POST of the session to the events URL of its gateway's link, application/cloudevents-batch+json: events of one run, in the session's order, never empty. Each is an event of the contract without sequence, and none is an event the gateway writes: the gateway numbers the run's stream, sends the ping as the node toward the server, and writes the run's dev.qory.run.egress. A dev.qory.run.started is opened by the session, a dev.qory.run.exited is the session's own, the runtime's exit, with timeout as the only one of Forager's reasons, or the reason of the run's starter the gateway's outcome answer gave, since the gateway writes the event of every other reason itself, and a dev.qory.run.refused has a code the session decides itself, those of refusal.Decides, and no name of the form <member>=<value>, which only a gateway's refusal carries. The gateway refuses a batch on rules the schema cannot state as well: the README's §The gateway's link lists them.

event.description: An event as event.schema.json defines it, with no sequence, and not dev.qory.ping or dev.qory.run.egress, which the gateway writes. A dev.qory.run.started has opened_by session, a dev.qory.run.exited's reason, when present, is timeout or none of Forager's other codes, run_closed and the three old names among them, and a dev.qory.run.refused's code is one the session decides itself, with no name labels.<key>=<value> or about.details.<key>=<value>.
